script_text: Stop! Taurus, the stars are screaming at you right now. The Moon in Virgo forms a precise trine to your ruling planet Venus in Capricorn in your ninth house, while Saturn in Pisces squares your Sun in your eleventh house of ambitions. As an earth sign, you feel this pull between spiritual reflection and stubborn security demands. In love, that Venus trine in your seventh house of partnerships means a partner will reveal hidden financial fears, so listen instead of retreating into silence. For singles, your magnetic energy attracts someone through shared values, not small talk. For career and money, Mercury in Sagittarius opposes Jupiter in your second house of income, warning against signing a contract or lending money without rereading the fine print. A blessing arrives through an unexpected gift from a friend in your eleventh house. Follow for tomorrow's reading.
